title: repo_index INDEX.json
description: Schema for the top-level INDEX.json artifact emitted by repo_index. See tools/repo_index/CONTRACTS.md sections 5.1 and 5.2.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. VOLATILE: excluded from content_digest.

root.description: Absolute root path that was indexed.

git_commit.description: Current HEAD sha at runtime, or null for a non-git root. VOLATILE: excluded from content_digest.

content_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical, path-sorted [(path,size_bytes,extractor,meta)] serialization EXCLUDING volatile fields (generated_at, git_commit, mtime_iso, error). CONTRACTS.md section 7.

config_used.description: Resolved configuration echoed for reproducibility (prune set, thresholds, category map, ontology tags).

entries.description: Per-file entries, sorted by path. Same object shape as each INDEX.jsonl line.

ext.description: Lowercased extension key (compound-aware, e.g. 'csv.gz'); empty string if none.

mtime_iso.description: ISO-8601 UTC mtime. VOLATILE: excluded from content_digest.

symlink_target.description: os.readlink(path) verbatim; null if not a symlink.

symlink_ok.description: null if not a symlink; true if target resolves; false if broken/dangling (health signal).

tags.description: Ontology tags from config regexes over the relative path; may be empty.

meta.description: Extractor return dict (CONTRACTS.md section 4); possibly empty. Shape varies by extractor; intentionally not constrained here.

error.description: extract_meta error string ('ExcType: message'). OMITTED when extraction succeeded.
